title: record() write-error accounting path (get_error -> _events decrement) is never exercised
evidence:
if _file.get_error() != OK:
		# The line did not reach disk — drop it from the count so the chip
		# never overstates what persisted (disk full, ejected media, ...).
		_events -= 1
		push_warning("playtest: write to %s failed (error %d) — event dropped" % [path, _file.get_error()])
detail: Open-failure and collision guards are covered, but this mid-write branch and its _events decrement never run in any test — a blind-spot the brief names explicitly.
recommended_fix: Inject a failing FileAccess after begin() (fill/readonly path) and assert event_count() excludes the dropped line and the warning fires.

title: tutor_open mode branching (scripted/llm/compare) has no test

title: buy/upgrade/repair/event/league_open/new_game/street_name_reroll hooks lack any verified coverage
evidence:
if not event.is_empty():
		_record("event", { ... "asset_name": event.get("asset_name", ""), })
	_record("buy", {"type": type_key, "name": asset_name})
	_record("upgrade", {"name": asset["name"], "level": asset["level"]})
	_record("repair", {"name": asset.get("name", "")})
		_record("street_name_reroll", {})
	_record("league_open", {})
		_record("new_game", {})
detail: These feed the scorecard's observation rows (assets, upgrade, event survived, league, reroll mash). No test drives the action/popup that fires them, so payloads and wiring are unverified.
recommended_fix: Extend the scene flow to buy, upgrade, repair an asset, run a market tick, open the leaderboard, tap NEW GAME, and mash street-name reroll; assert each event.

title: age_picked and street_name records are bypassed — the test emits the signals directly
evidence:
func _on_age_picked(bracket: String) -> void:
	_record("age_picked", {"bracket": bracket})
	_close_popup()
	_age_picked.emit(bracket)
---
accept.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
	_record("street_name", {"name": current["name"]})
	_street_name_picked.emit(current["name"])
)
--- test:
		_street._age_picked.emit("8-10")
		_street._street_name_picked.emit("Fresh Lane")
detail: Both handlers record-then-emit; the test emits the signals directly, skipping the handlers, so age_picked and street_name are absent from the log, not merely unasserted.
recommended_fix: Press the real age ACCEPT and street-name ACCEPT buttons via their pressed signal instead of emitting _age_picked/_street_name_picked, so the record handlers run.
